about: A graha in a rashi, as against a graha in a bhava. The two are different questions and the base had only the second: planet-in-house said where a graha acts, and nothing said what the sign it stands in makes of it. Read out of Saravali, which gives a chapter to each graha through the twelve rashis - the Sun in ch. 22, the Moon in ch. 23, Mars 25, Mercury 26, Jupiter 27, Venus 28 and Saturn 29 - and cited by verse. Only the primary statement for each sign is taken; each chapter follows it with sub-verses on what happens when another graha aspects that placement, which the engine has no condition for yet. Rahu and Ketu are covered differently, because no text in the collection reads them through the twelve rashis: Saravali's chapters are for the seven, and BPHS vol. 1 names a node in a rashi only as a condition inside its dasha verses. What does exist is Phaladeepika ch. 4, which lists the signs in which each node is strong, so the nine rules that result say that and no more. Writing twelve readings apiece to fill the grid would have been the opposite of citing a text. These readings are blunt and often unflattering, and some of their terms belong to the society that produced them rather than to ours. They are rendered as the text has them, in original wording, because a knowledge base that quietly improves its sources is no longer reporting them.

rules.name: Sun in Aries
rules.says: Expounds the sacred texts and is known in the arts; fond of a fight, fierce, dutiful and restless. Strong-boned, and prone to bilious and blood disorders.

rules.name: Sun in Taurus
rules.says: Trouble in the face and the eyes, and a thin frame that endures more than it looks able to. Few sons, but a fortunate and well-favoured life.

rules.name: Sun in Gemini
rules.says: A scholar and sweet-spoken, well conducted, learned in both sacred and worldly knowledge, and markedly well off. Liberal, skilful, and given to astrology.

rules.name: Sun in Cancer
rules.says: Unsteady in what is undertaken, yet famed for a certain royal quality. Falls out with his own people, and marriage is the unfortunate part of the life.

rules.name: Sun in Leo
rules.says: Destroys his enemies and is quick to anger. Does notable things, keeps to wild and solitary places, and is enthusiastic, valorous and conspicuous.

rules.name: Sun in Virgo
rules.says: A scholar and an expert writer, learned and given to service of the gods, but physically weak and soft of build.

rules.name: Sun in Libra
rules.says: Frustration, ruin and heavy expense; living abroad out of distress rather than choice. Saravali is blunt about the character here.

rules.name: Sun in Scorpio
rules.says: An appetite for conflict that does not serve him, a turn away from religion, untruthfulness and dullness, and an unhappy marriage.

rules.name: Sun in Sagittarius
rules.says: Wealthy and well regarded by those in power, learned, reverent towards the gods and the learned, and skilled in the training of arms.

rules.name: Sun in Capricorn
rules.says: Advances by mean work and keeps mean company: greedy, timid, fickle, short of relatives, fond of wandering and not strong.

rules.name: Sun in Aquarius
rules.says: Heart trouble and a very short temper set against considerable courage. Fortune through other men's households, and widely disliked.

rules.name: Sun in Pisces
rules.says: Friendly and acquisitive, fond of women and content, learned, and able to see off enemies. Wealth comes and stays.

rules.name: Moon in Aries
rules.says: A golden complexion and lasting wealth, valorous and self-respecting, prosperous - and commonly without siblings.

rules.name: Moon in Taurus
rules.says: Large-hearted and markedly charitable, famous and brilliant, with fine eyes, and daughters rather than sons.

rules.name: Moon in Gemini
rules.says: A prominent nose and dark eyes; skilled in the art of love and in poetry, and takes pleasure where it is found.

rules.name: Moon in Cancer
rules.says: Fortunate and brave, settled in a house of his own, with friends, travel and a turn for astrology. Sensuous, grateful, and fit for office.

rules.name: Moon in Leo
rules.says: Sturdy bones, sparse hair, a wide face and small yellowish eyes. Averse to women, troubled by hunger and thirst and by stomach disorders.

rules.name: Moon in Virgo
rules.says: An attractive face and body and a learned mind, fit to teach religion - set against an appetite for women that the text treats as an addiction.

rules.name: Moon in Libra
rules.says: A raised nose and broad eyes over a thin frame and a weak face. Many wives and much cattle.

rules.name: Moon in Scorpio
rules.says: Miserly and coarse-built, cruel in what he does, and inclined to theft. Sickly in childhood.

rules.name: Moon in Sagittarius
rules.says: Short, round-eyed, broad through the heart and waist, with prominent shoulders - and a good speaker.

rules.name: Moon in Capricorn
rules.says: A singer, stoutly built and averse to the cold, fond of truth and of giving, and distinguished in what he does.

rules.name: Moon in Aquarius
rules.says: A raised nose and a rough, uneven body with heavy limbs. Given to drink and out of sympathy with the virtuous.

rules.name: Moon in Pisces
rules.says: Expert in the fine arts and proficient in music, learned in the sacred texts, and able to win over even those set against him.

rules.name: Mars in Aries
rules.says: Splendid, truthful and valorous, fit to command; fond of war and of adventure, charitable, and fierce with it.

rules.name: Mars in Taurus
rules.says: Voracious and jealous, harsh-spoken and slow to trust, with little wealth and few sons, though fond of music. Saravali reads the morals here harshly.

rules.name: Mars in Gemini
rules.says: Splendid and able to endure misery; very learned, versed in poetics and skilled in the fine arts, fond of foreign travel and highly intelligent.

rules.name: Mars in Cancer
rules.says: Lives in other people's houses, misshapen and sickly, yet grows rich by the land. Royal food and clothing in childhood.

rules.name: Mars in Leo
rules.says: Impatient and brave, bent on taking what belongs to others, and happiest away from settled places.

rules.name: Mars in Virgo
rules.says: Worthy of honour and soft and sweet in speech, very fond of union and of music - and never rich.

rules.name: Mars in Libra
rules.says: Given to wandering and to poor business, though an able speaker and fortunate with it. A limb is marked or malformed.

rules.name: Mars in Scorpio
rules.says: Drawn to trade and to sacred knowledge alike, skilful in his duties and interested in war - and, Saravali says, fit to lead thieves.

rules.name: Mars in Sagittarius
rules.says: A warrior with chariots and elephants at his command, and marked by it: many wounds, a thin frame, harsh speech and a crafty, estranged temper.

rules.name: Mars in Capricorn
rules.says: Wealthy and happy, of excellent disposition, famous, and fit to command an army.

rules.name: Mars in Aquarius
rules.says: Without affection or purity, looking older than his years, spiteful and jealous, and coming to a bad end.

rules.name: Mars in Pisces
rules.says: Troubled by illness, living abroad, slighted by his own relatives, and getting little from his children.

rules.name: Mercury in Aries
rules.says: Very learned and drawn to music and dance, but contentious, untruthful and thin.

rules.name: Mercury in Taurus
rules.says: Skilful and eminently liberal, famous, versed in the sacred texts, and fond of exercise, fine clothes and ornament.

rules.name: Mercury in Gemini
rules.says: An auspicious appearance and a sweet tongue; an able speaker, honourable, and markedly affluent.

rules.name: Mercury in Cancer
rules.says: Learned and fond of living abroad, drawn to women and to music, and fickle and talkative with it.

rules.name: Mercury in Leo
rules.says: Famous in the world and little troubled by truth - and, Saravali says plainly, without much wisdom.

rules.name: Mercury in Virgo
rules.says: Virtuous, eloquent and skilful, learned, and accomplished in writing and poetry. Mercury's own and exaltation sign.

rules.name: Mercury in Libra
rules.says: Knows the arts and argues well, an able speaker in business - and spends freely.

rules.name: Mercury in Scorpio
rules.says: Trouble, grief and ill-doing; hostile to the virtuous and short of truth, religion and shame.

rules.name: Mercury in Sagittarius
rules.says: Famous and liberal, learned in the sacred texts, valorous, given to meditation, and fit to be a minister.

rules.name: Mercury in Capricorn
rules.says: Does other people's work and gets little by it: dull, mean, devoid of virtue and subject to many miseries.

rules.name: Mercury in Aquarius
rules.says: Attached to religious observance while giving up what is worth doing; poorly disposed and slighted for it.

rules.name: Mercury in Pisces
rules.says: Fond of good conduct and purity, living abroad, with a chaste wife and a fortunate turn - but poor, and often without children.

rules.name: Jupiter in Aries
rules.says: Argumentative by disposition, acquiring gems and ornaments by his own effort, strong, and with sons.

rules.name: Jupiter in Taurus
rules.says: Broad and heavy of build, splendid and fortunate, attached to his wife, and reverent towards the learned and the gods.

rules.name: Jupiter in Gemini
rules.says: Affluent and scholarly, proficient and eloquent, courteous and virtuous, with attractive eyes, and respectful of elders.

rules.name: Jupiter in Cancer
rules.says: A scholar, handsome and highly learned, charitable and good-natured, very strong and famous, with abundant grain and riches and long-lived sons. Jupiter's exaltation.

rules.name: Jupiter in Leo
rules.says: Strong and courageous, learned and rich, with eminent relatives and abundant friendship - and enmities that last.

rules.name: Jupiter in Virgo
rules.says: A scholar, virtuous and skilful at his work, fond of scents, robes and flowers, and holding firmly what he gains.

rules.name: Jupiter in Libra
rules.says: A scholar with many sons and work that takes him abroad; very affluent, fond of ornament, and modest with it.

rules.name: Jupiter in Scorpio
rules.says: Expert in the sacred texts and fit to rule, and a commentator who explains them line by line.

rules.name: Jupiter in Sagittarius
rules.says: A teacher who conducts vows, initiations and sacrifices; lasting wealth, charitable and friendly. Jupiter's own sign.

rules.name: Jupiter in Capricorn
rules.says: Much grief and difficulty, mean conduct and dullness, little vigour, and a bad end. Jupiter's fall.

rules.name: Jupiter in Aquarius
rules.says: Carries tales and is drawn to bad work and base company, though chief among his own people.

rules.name: Jupiter in Pisces
rules.says: Expert in the meaning of the Vedas and the sacred texts, honoured by friends and by the virtuous, and senior in a ruler's service.

rules.name: Venus in Aries
rules.says: Blemished and hostile, night-blind, keeping to wild places, and pursuing women outside his own household.

rules.name: Venus in Taurus
rules.says: Many wives and gems, a life on the land and by cattle, with scents, garlands and fine robes, and charitable with it. Venus's own sign.

rules.name: Venus in Gemini
rules.says: Famous in the sciences, beautiful and skilled in writing and poetry, dear to good people - and frankly sensual.

rules.name: Venus in Cancer
rules.says: Wise, virtuous and learned, strong and gentle, chief among men, good-looking and just, with the happiness and wealth he wanted.

rules.name: Venus in Leo
rules.says: Respects women, enjoys wealth and ease, and is dear to his relatives - yet unhappy in the middle of it, and short of vigour.

rules.name: Venus in Virgo
rules.says: Soft, skilful and sweet-spoken, helpful to others and earning from several sources - but undiscriminating, and without pleasure in any of it. Venus's fall.

rules.name: Venus in Libra
rules.says: Hard-earned money and fine clothing, valorous, fond of living abroad, and protective of his own people. Venus's own sign.

rules.name: Venus in Scorpio
rules.says: Jealous and malicious, argumentative and crafty, irreligious, estranged from his brothers, and unlucky with it.

rules.name: Venus in Sagittarius
rules.says: Good results follow from virtue, duty and wealth alike; dear to everyone, splendid, and an excellent man by the text's reckoning.

rules.name: Venus in Capricorn
rules.says: Wretched through heavy expense, thin, miserly where it matters, troubled by the heart, and drawn to older women.

rules.name: Venus in Aquarius
rules.says: Fear and agitation, undertakings that do not succeed, and hostility towards elders and children. Pursues women outside the household.

rules.name: Venus in Pisces
rules.says: Courteous, liberal and virtuous, very wealthy and famous, able to see off enemies, and dear to those in power. Venus's exaltation.

rules.name: Saturn in Aries
rules.says: Wretched through his own vices and through hard labour; deceitful, garrulous, at odds with his relatives and ill thought of. Saturn's fall.

rules.name: Saturn in Taurus
rules.says: Without wealth and in service, untruthful and ill-spoken, and winning the regard of older women.

rules.name: Saturn in Gemini
rules.says: Debt and imprisonment, toil, and vanity of disposition; given to hymns and prayers while short of virtue.

rules.name: Saturn in Cancer
rules.says: A beloved wife, learning and soft speech, and distinction in what he does - against poverty in boyhood, much illness, and the loss of the mother.

rules.name: Saturn in Leo
rules.says: Drawn to reading and writing and skilful with it, but disdained, living by service, and short of virtue, wife and his own people.

rules.name: Saturn in Virgo
rules.says: Very crafty, dependent on others for food, few friends, and given to prostitutes.

rules.name: Saturn in Libra
rules.says: Rich and soft-spoken, earning money and honour from abroad, fit to rule or to be a scholar, with wealth that his relatives protect. Saturn's exaltation.

rules.name: Saturn in Scorpio
rules.says: Hostile and crooked, ill-tempered, miserly and egoistic, and troubled by poison and weapons - and rich with it.

rules.name: Saturn in Sagittarius
rules.says: Skilful in conduct, in teaching and in the meaning of the sacred texts, and famous for his virtue.

rules.name: Saturn in Capricorn
rules.says: Holds Vedic learning and knowledge of many of the fine arts, and lords it over what belongs to others. Saturn's own sign.

rules.name: Saturn in Aquarius
rules.says: A great liar, eminent and crafty, given to women and wine, ill-tempered, and falling in with bad friends. Saturn's own sign.

rules.name: Saturn in Pisces
rules.says: Fond of sacrifice and of the arts, calm, chief among his relatives and friends, skilful in policy, and with increasing wealth.

rules.name: Rahu in Aries
rules.says: Rahu stands in a sign where Phaladeepika counts it strong, so what it signifies comes through at full force. Strength is not the same as benefit: a strong shadow graha gives its own results plainly, for better and for worse.
rules.note: Phaladeepika lists the signs in which each node is strong, in the chapter on the six strengths. It is the nearest thing to a sign doctrine for the nodes in the reference collection: Saravali gives a chapter to each of the seven grahas through the twelve rashis and none to Rahu or Ketu, and BPHS vol. 1 names them in a rashi only as a condition inside its dasha verses.

It is the nearest thing to a sign doctrine for the nodes in the reference collection: Saravali gives a chapter to each of the seven grahas through the twelve rashis and none to Rahu or Ketu, and BPHS vol. 1 names them in a rashi only as a condition inside its dasha verses. The text restricts this to the latter half of Sagittarius. The condition language tests whole signs, so this fires across the sign and overstates it for a node in the first fifteen degrees - which is why its confidence is lower than the rest.
